# Code of conduct

Kadhai is built in the open by people with different skills, languages and amounts of time. This is how we treat each other in issues, discussions, pull requests and anywhere else connected with the project.

## What we expect

- Be kind and patient, and assume good intent.
- Criticise ideas and code, never people.
- Help newcomers find their way; everyone started somewhere.
- Accept that the maintainer decides what goes into the project, and why.

## What is not accepted

- Harassment, insults, threats or personal attacks.
- Comments about someone's identity, background or appearance.
- Sharing someone's private details without their permission.
- Spam, or repeatedly pushing the same point after it has been answered.

## What happens

The maintainer may edit, hide or remove anything that breaks this code, and may block people who keep doing it. Decisions are made case by case, and the aim is always to keep the project a good place to work.

## Reporting

If someone's behaviour worries you, use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment (the `...` menu), or **Report abuse** on their profile. Reports are handled privately.

This code applies to everyone, the maintainer included.
